verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a day-one business bank account and a Money Dashboard that puts cash balance, inflows and outflows in one view, alongside its payroll platform. That covers the banking slice of consolidation, but the capability is in early beta and nothing in the pack shows spend management or bill pay. Missing for 10: spend management/corporate cards, bill pay, general availability beyond early beta, and independent hands-on corroboration of consolidation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform

citations.quote: Gusto is expanding beyond its payroll, benefits, and compliance platform into business formation and banking products
An updated Money Dashboard brings finances into one view including cash balance, what's coming in, what's going out, and what's coming up next.
These capabilities are in early beta and will roll out to more entrepreneurs in the coming months.
